scope: Arithmetic-only subperiod evaluation of saved P1 V2 predictions
user_authorization: Sonuçları yorumla ve hocanın istediği alt dönem değerlendirmesini yap. Yeni eğitim başlatma; tez dosyasını değiştirme.
period_assignment_date: Canonical target realization date, not input_end_date or anchor t

boundary_selection.rule: Calendar year boundaries; exhaustive partition; no optimization over errors or events
boundary_selection.timing: Specified for this post-review analysis before computing subperiod performance. Full-period results were already known.

models.ensemble: Reuse the existing arithmetic mean of three raw float64 predictions; verify exact identity without re-running models
models.naive: Reuse verified ReturnZero and Vol20 at latest admitted input date t-1 predictions

populations.matching: Same target date, asset, task and mask for every compared prediction; report n

numeric_rules.precision: float64 saved raw truth and predictions, subtraction and reductions
numeric_rules.R2: 1-SSE/SST with the true mean within the same period and mask; undefined for n<2 or constant truth
numeric_rules.paired_relative_change: 100*(MAE-arm primary loss minus MSE-arm primary loss)/MSE-arm primary loss; negative favors MAE
numeric_rules.naive_ratio: Model primary loss divided by matched naive primary loss within the SAME period and mask
numeric_rules.zero_denominator_or_empty: Explicit undefined/null status; no epsilon substitution
numeric_rules.macro: Equal weight across exactly four asset metrics; any undefined asset metric leaves that macro metric undefined; n per asset retained
numeric_rules.cross_task_total: Do not add raw return and volatility errors

reconstruction.partition: Exactly one of three disjoint periods for every one of 584 primary dates
reconstruction.additive_losses: Use n-weighted period MAE, MSE and pinball to reproduce full-period losses separately for each asset/model/mask
reconstruction.RMSE: sqrt of reconstructed MSE; not average of period RMSE
reconstruction.R2_and_quantiles: Recompute from pooled saved observations; do not average period R2, medians or percentiles
reconstruction.full_reference: Match existing metrics_by_asset.csv and metrics_equal_asset_macro.csv where those metrics were already recorded

interpretation_limits: 2022 is a shorter partial period; raw error magnitudes across years also reflect changing target variability.
Adjacent Vol20 targets share 19 returns, including across year boundaries; periods are not independent statistical samples.
Saved features and targets keep their original historical windows across calendar boundaries; do not restart rolling calculations in January.
This is a descriptive fixed-model evaluation, not rolling-origin retraining or a new unseen external test.
No new significance tests or seed-times-date pseudo-replication.
No choice of model, loss weight, seed or protocol based on these test results.
P1 still uses an assumption-based information cutoff; historical first availability and vintage times remain unverified.
